note: Cuming County zoning is published as a PDF zoning map (adopted 2020) and inside a vendor web viewer (gisworkshop/gworks) whose zoning layer is not exposed as an ArcGIS REST or other queryable service; the gisworkshop and gworks hosts did not answer REST probes.
